en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 13. My father narrated to me from Ḥusain ibn Ḥasan ibn Abān, from Muḥammad ibn Ūramah, from Naďr ibn Suwayd, from ‘Āsim ibn Ḥumayd, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I heard Abā Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) say: When the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) would pass by the graves of a group of believers, he would say, “Salām upon the dwellings of the believers. In-Shā`allāh we shall join you.”
